캡션(영어): Jigyungdajim is a folk song that originated from the labor songs sung while firmly compacting the ground before building a house, and it exemplifies the characteristics of Namdo folk songs well. This piece is known by various names depending on the region and tradition, with its central theme revolving around the hope for a well-built house and the arrival of good fortune. The voice of the female vocalist Lee Joo-eun serves as a crucial element in guiding the development of the song. She employs clear vocalization to express the melody of the piece and effectively utilizes shikimsae to maintain a traditional feel. Lee Joo-eun adjusts her vocal volume and breath in accordance with the flow of the song, and while riding the rhythm of the Jungjungmori jangdan, she emphasizes each syllable to highlight the theme. Her breath gracefully adorns the conclusion of the piece, contributing to the traditional completeness of the folk music. Overall, Lee Joo-eun's singing effectively conveys the content and emotions of Jigyungdajim, reflecting the unique characteristics of Namdo folk songs.

캡션(한국어): 이어도사나는 제주 해녀들이 배를 타고 나가며 노를 저을 때 부르는 노동요로, 남도민요의 특징이 잘 드러나는 민속악 장르의 곡이다. 이 곡은 '이어도 사나'라는 후렴구를 중심으로 거친 바다와 삶을 노래하며, 이상향인 이어도를 향한 동경과 현실의 고단함이 교차하는 내용을 담고 있다. 여창 가창자 이주은의 목소리는 이 곡의 흐름을 이끌어가는 중요한 요소로 작용한다. 그녀는 발성에서 안정감을 유지하며, 중중모리 장단에 맞춰 리드미컬하게 멜로디를 표현한다. 이주은은 시김새를 적절히 사용하여 곡의 감정을 전달하며, 성량 또한 곡의 전개에 따라 유연하게 조절한다. 그녀의 호흡은 긴 구절을 자연스럽게 이어가며 곡의 흐름을 매끄럽게 만들어준다. 중중모리의 리듬 위에서 이주은은 곡의 구조에 맞춰 호흡을 조절하며, 마무리 부분에서는 호흡으로 곡의 여운을 남기고 장르적 완성도를 높인다. 이처럼 이주은의 가창은 이어도사나의 테마와 감정을 효과적으로 전달하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다.
캡션(영어): Ieodo Sanana is a labor song sung by Jeju haenyeo (female divers) as they row their boats, representing a genre of folk music that distinctly showcases the characteristics of Namdo minyo (Southern Korean folk songs). This piece revolves around the refrain "Ieodo Sana," expressing the harshness of the sea and life, while intertwining a longing for the idealized land of Ieodo with the hardships of reality. The voice of the female vocalist Lee Joo-eun serves as a crucial element that guides the flow of the song. She maintains a sense of stability in her vocalization and rhythmically articulates the melody in accordance with the Jungjungmori jangdan (rhythmic pattern). Lee Joo-eun effectively employs vocal embellishments to convey the emotions of the piece, while also flexibly adjusting her vocal volume in relation to the song's progression. Her breath control allows for seamless transitions through long phrases, enhancing the smoothness of the overall flow. Over the rhythm of Jungjungmori, Lee Joo-eun modulates her breathing in alignment with the structure of the song, leaving a lingering resonance in the concluding section and elevating the genre's completeness. In this way, Lee Joo-eun's singing plays a vital role in effectively conveying the themes and emotions of Ieodo Sanana.

This song captures the essence of the seasons, such as the spring flowers and summer water play, with a lively rhythm, expressing the emotions tied to the changes of the seasons. The voice of the female vocalist, Yeom Gyeong-ae, is a crucial element that guides the flow of the piece, as her vocalization and embellishments effectively embody the traits of traditional folk songs. Yeom Gyeong-ae naturally navigates the melody in accordance with the rhythm of Jungjungmori, clearly articulating each syllable. Her vocal strength solidifies the overall structure of the piece, and through breath control, she maintains the tension of the song. In particular, her appropriate use of embellishments highlights the changes in the melody, reinterpreting traditional elements with a modern sensibility. Riding the flow of the piece over the rhythm of Jungjungmori, the vocalist's breath adorns the conclusion of the song, leaving a natural resonance. The combination of these elements enhances the genre's completeness, allowing listeners to vividly experience the changes of the seasons.

This singing technique harmonizes with the rhythmic quality of traditional folk music, adding depth to the composition. Riding the rhythm of Jungjungmori, Jo Jeong-hee navigates the flow of the piece, with her breath playing a crucial role in embellishing the conclusion of the song. Her breathing is seamlessly and flexibly integrated, contributing to the overall completeness of the performance.

캡션(한국어): 봄타령은 봄의 경치와 설레는 마음을 노래한 남도 통속민요로, 화사한 봄날의 정경을 남도 특유의 선율로 표현한 곡이다. 이 곡은 생동감 넘치는 봄의 기운을 만끽할 수 있는 밝은 분위기를 지니며, 민속악 장르의 특성을 잘 드러내는 민요로서, 특히 남도민요의 특징을 강조하고 있다. 여창 가창자 조정희의 목소리는 이 곡을 에너지 넘치는 방식으로 이끌어간다. 그녀는 멜로디를 표현하는 데 있어 생동감 있는 발성과 시김새를 사용하여 청중에게 봄의 기운을 효과적으로 전달한다. 조정희는 성량이 풍부하며, 호흡을 적절히 조절하여 각 구절의 감정을 잘 살리고, 곡의 흐름에 자연스럽게 녹아든다. 중중모리의 리듬 위에서 그녀는 경쾌하게 흐름을 타며, 리듬에 맞춰 목소리를 유연하게 조절하여 곡의 전체적인 완성도를 높인다. 그녀의 호흡은 곡의 마무리를 장식하는 데 중요한 역할을 하며, 이로 인해 곡의 에너지를 더욱 강조하고 청중에게 깊은 여운을 남긴다.
캡션(영어): Bomtayoung is a popular folk song from the Namdo region that sings of the scenery of spring and the fluttering heart it brings, expressing the vibrant landscape of a bright spring day through the unique melodies characteristic of Namdo. This piece embodies a cheerful atmosphere that allows listeners to fully enjoy the lively energy of spring, effectively showcasing the traits of the folk music genre, particularly emphasizing the characteristics of Namdo folk songs. The voice of female vocalist Jo Jeong-hee leads this piece in an energetic manner. She employs vivid vocalization and expressive nuances to convey the spirit of spring to the audience. Jo Jeong-hee possesses a rich vocal timbre and skillfully manages her breath to enhance the emotions of each phrase, seamlessly integrating into the flow of the piece. Riding on the rhythm of Jungjungmori, she moves gracefully with the tempo, flexibly adjusting her voice to elevate the overall quality of the song. Her breath plays a crucial role in embellishing the conclusion of the piece, thereby further emphasizing its energy and leaving a profound resonance with the audience.

캡션(영어): Ieodo Sanana is a labor song sung by the haenyeo (female divers) of Jeju while they row their boats, exemplifying the characteristics of Jeju folk music and its traditional melodies. This piece captures the essence of the tumultuous sea and life through its refrain "Ieodo Sana," intertwining a longing for the idealized land of Ieodo with the hardships of reality. The voice of the female vocalist Chae Su-hyun serves as the central element of this piece, with her vocalization naturally and flexibly expressing the melody based on traditional singing techniques. By appropriately employing vocal embellishments, she reveals the unique timbre of Jeju folk songs, and her vocal power is adjusted according to the flow of the piece, providing a profound resonance for the audience. Her breath is skillfully divided to clearly convey each phrase of the song, and particularly in the refrain, she emphasizes the rhythm with strong breath support. Riding the lively rhythm of the Jajinmori, Chae Su-hyun navigates the flow of the song effortlessly, and her breath contributes to the conclusion of the piece, enhancing its genre-specific completeness. These elements combine to further highlight the traditional charm of Ieodo Sanana.

캡션(영어): The Chuseok Moon is a folk song that expresses wishes while gazing at the full moon of Chuseok, embodying the festive spirit characteristic of Gyeonggi folk music. This piece captures the abundance associated with the round moon and the warmth of familial bonds through its gentle melodies, allowing listeners to experience the essence of traditional folk music. Vocalist Kim Min-ji conveys a narrative through her voice, creating an exhilarating atmosphere. Her vocal technique effectively expresses the song's liveliness, and she skillfully employs vocal ornamentation to convey emotion. With her rich vocal tone, she naturally guides the flow of the melody, and her breath control adeptly reflects the tension and relaxation within the piece. Riding on the rhythm of the gutgeori, she moves rhythmically, embellishing the ends of each phrase with breath, which enhances the song's conclusion. Kim Min-ji's singing beautifully captures the charm of traditional Gyeonggi folk music, elevating the genre's overall completeness.

캡션(한국어): 양유가는 경기민요의 한 곡으로, 버들가지를 소재로 한 서정적인 내용이 담겨 있다. 이 곡은 버드나무가 늘어선 봄 풍경과 이별의 정한을 굿거리장단에 담아내어, 경기민요의 특징인 부드럽고 유연한 소리의 매력을 잘 보여준다. 여창 가창자 김민지의 목소리는 이 곡을 이끌어가는 중심 요소로, 그녀는 창법에서 전통적인 경기민요의 기법을 충실히 따르며 곡의 감성을 전달한다. 김민지는 시김새를 통해 멜로디의 변화를 자연스럽게 표현하며, 발성은 안정적이고 힘이 있다. 그녀의 성량은 곡의 흐름을 따라 유연하게 변화하며, 호흡 조절이 뛰어나 긴 음을 끌어내는 데도 능숙하다. 굿거리장단의 리듬 위에서 김민지는 경쾌하게 흐름을 타면서도, 각 구절의 마무리에서는 호흡을 잘 조절하여 곡의 완성도를 높인다. 그녀의 호흡은 곡의 마무리에서 자연스럽게 이어지며, 전체적인 리듬감을 더욱 강조한다.
캡션(영어): Yangyuga is a piece from Gyeonggi folk song, characterized by its lyrical content centered around willow branches. This song captures the essence of spring scenery adorned with willows and the sorrow of parting, expressed through the Gukgeori Jangdan rhythm, effectively showcasing the charm of Gyeonggi folk music's soft and fluid sounds. The voice of the female vocalist Kim Min-ji serves as the central element guiding this piece, as she faithfully adheres to the traditional techniques of Gyeonggi folk singing, conveying the emotional depth of the song. Kim Min-ji naturally expresses the changes in melody through her vocal embellishments, while her singing technique is stable and powerful. Her vocal range flexibly adapts to the flow of the piece, and her breath control is exceptional, allowing her to sustain long notes with ease. Riding the lively rhythm of Gukgeori Jangdan, Kim Min-ji maintains a buoyant flow, skillfully managing her breath at the end of each phrase to enhance the overall quality of the piece. Her breath seamlessly transitions at the conclusion of the song, further emphasizing the overall sense of rhythm.

This piece is a type of folk music that distinctly showcases the characteristics of Gyeonggi minyo, sung to the Ggutgeori Jangdan, with a lively melody that evokes feelings of abundance and leisure. The voice of female vocalist Kim Min-ji further accentuates the cheerful atmosphere of the song. She expresses the melody clearly through her strong vocal power and distinct pronunciation, effectively employing vocal embellishments to enhance the rhythm and emotion of the piece. Kim Min-ji skillfully manages her breath to connect each phrase naturally, contributing to the maintenance of an exhilarating ambiance. Her voice flows smoothly over the rhythm of the Ggutgeori, providing enjoyment to the audience as it rides the overall flow of the song. In the conclusion of the piece, her breath leaves a lingering resonance, further emphasizing the traditional charm of Gyeonggi minyo.

캡션(영어): Ganggangsullae 2 is a folk music piece that distinctly showcases the characteristics of Namdo Minyo, adhering to the traditional form of Ganggangsullae. This composition is constructed from the notes mi-mi, la-la, si-si, and do-do′, and is characterized by the use of Yukjabaegi Tori, where the note mi is elongated and delivered with a strong emphasis, while do and si are expressed with a bending technique, concluding on la. The female vocalist Jo Jeong-hee effectively embodies traditional singing techniques in this piece, particularly highlighting her skill in sustaining the note mi. Her voice leads the flow of the composition, with clear expressions of the nuances and delicate embellishments, while also transitioning to simpler melodies that align with the brisk tempo of Jajinmori, which adds an intriguing dynamic. Jo Jeong-hee adeptly manages her breath to seamlessly connect the melodic flow, moving fluidly in accordance with the rhythm of the piece. Within the lively rhythm of Jajinmori, her breath elegantly concludes the composition, enhancing the overall quality of traditional folk music. Through Jo Jeong-hee's performance, the traditional charm of Ganggangsullae is effectively conveyed.

This song serves as a repertoire that enhances the festive spirit of the holiday, encapsulating the dynamic energy of the soaring Nulnori in a lively jangdan. It is characterized by a brisk tempo of Jungjungmori, sung joyfully and rapidly. The voice of the female vocalist Jo Jeong-hee is a central element that drives this piece, as she clearly articulates the melody through strong vocalization and stable breath control based on traditional singing techniques. By appropriately utilizing sigimsae, she enriches the rhythm and emotion of the piece, while adjusting her vocal range to maintain stability across both high and low notes. Jo Jeong-hee's breath seamlessly connects the flow of the song, allowing for flexible variations over the cheerful rhythm of Jungjungmori, thereby modulating the tension of the piece. Her breath also plays a crucial role in the conclusion of the song, extending the final note to leave a lingering impression on the audience and contributing to the overall artistic completeness of the genre.

캡션(한국어): 동백타령은 1961년 한일섭 명인이 작곡한 남도 신민요로, 동백꽃 예찬과 연인의 설렘을 남도계면조 선율에 담아낸 곡이다. 이 곡은 서정적이면서도 구성진 남도 소리의 맛을 잘 살려낸 민속악 장르의 민요로, 남도민요의 특징이 잘 드러난다. 여창 가창자 조정희의 목소리는 이 곡을 이끌어가는 중요한 요소로, 그녀의 발성은 뚜렷하고 안정적이며, 중중모리의 리듬에 잘 어우러진다. 그녀는 멜로디를 표현하는 데 있어 유려한 시김새를 사용하며, 각 음의 길이를 조절하여 감정을 전달한다. 성량 또한 적절하게 조절되어 곡의 흐름을 자연스럽게 이어간다. 호흡은 긴 음을 부를 때 안정적으로 유지되며, 곡의 전개에 따라 적절한 곳에서 숨을 고르는 기술이 돋보인다. 중중모리의 리듬 위에서 가창자는 그 흐름을 타며 곡의 에너지를 유지하고, 마지막 부분에서는 호흡을 통해 곡을 부드럽게 마무리하여 장르적 완성도를 높인다. 조정희의 목소리는 이 곡의 서정성을 한층 더 강조하며, 남도민요의 전통을 잘 이어간다.
캡션(영어): Dongbaek Taryeong is a Namdo folk song composed by the renowned Han Il-seop in 1961, celebrating the camellia flower and the excitement of love, encapsulated within the melodic structure of Namdo gye-myeonjo. This piece is a lyrical yet richly textured example of the folk music genre, showcasing the distinctive characteristics of Namdo minyo. The voice of female vocalist Jo Jeong-hee serves as a crucial element in guiding the song, with her clear and stable vocalization harmonizing well with the rhythm of Jungjungmori. She employs fluid ornamentation to express the melody, skillfully adjusting the length of each note to convey emotion. Her vocal volume is also appropriately modulated, allowing for a seamless flow throughout the piece. Breath control is maintained steadily during long notes, with her technique of taking breaths at suitable moments during the song's progression standing out. Riding the rhythm of Jungjungmori, the vocalist sustains the energy of the piece, and in the final section, she gently concludes the song through her breath, enhancing the overall artistic completeness of the genre. Jo Jeong-hee's voice further emphasizes the lyrical quality of this piece, effectively continuing the tradition of Namdo minyo.

캡션(한국어): 신뱃노래 2는 경기민요 뱃노래의 가사에 남도 육자배기토리를 접목시킨 곡으로, 남도민요의 특징이 잘 드러나는 민속악의 일종이다. 이 곡은 뱃사람들의 애환과 흥취를 깊이 있게 표현하며, 여창 가창자 조정희의 목소리가 곡의 중심을 이끌어간다. 조정희는 곡의 전반에 걸쳐 섬세한 발성으로 멜로디를 표현하며, 전통적인 시김새를 적절히 사용하여 감정의 깊이를 더한다. 그녀의 성량은 곡의 리듬에 맞춰 안정적으로 유지되며, 호흡 조절이 잘 이루어져 곡의 흐름을 자연스럽게 이어간다. 특히 자진모리의 빠른 리듬 속에서도 그녀의 목소리는 명확하게 발음되며, 각 음절이 뚜렷하게 전달된다. 이러한 창법은 곡의 긴장감을 유지하면서도, 조정희의 호흡이 곡의 마무리를 장식하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다. 그녀의 호흡은 리듬의 변화에 맞춰 유연하게 조절되며, 전체적으로 곡의 완성도를 높이는 데 기여한다.
캡션(영어): Sinbaetnora 2 is a piece that integrates the lyrics of the Gyeonggi folk song Baetnorae with the Namdo Yukjabaegi rhythmic pattern, representing a type of folk music that distinctly showcases the characteristics of Namdo folk songs. This composition profoundly expresses the joys and sorrows of boatmen, with the voice of female vocalist Jo Jeong-hee leading the piece. Throughout the song, Jo Jeong-hee articulates the melody with delicate vocalization, appropriately employing traditional singing techniques to enhance the emotional depth. Her vocal strength is maintained steadily in accordance with the rhythm of the piece, and her breath control is executed well, allowing for a natural flow throughout the composition. Notably, even within the fast tempo of the Jajinmori rhythm, her voice is pronounced clearly, with each syllable distinctly conveyed. This singing style preserves the tension of the piece while Jo Jeong-hee's breath plays a crucial role in embellishing the conclusion of the song. Her breath is flexibly adjusted to match the changes in rhythm, contributing overall to the completeness of the composition.

캡션(한국어): 물레타령은 남도 통속민요로 정착된 곡으로, 물레질을 하며 부르던 노동요의 특징을 지닌 민속악 > 민요 장르의 곡이다. 이 곡은 물레 돌아가는 소리를 묘사한 후렴구와 함께 여성들의 노동과 삶의 애환을 경쾌하게 풀어내는 데 중점을 두고 있다. 여창 가창자 이주은의 목소리는 묵직한 음색을 바탕으로 곡을 이끌어가며, 그녀의 발성은 안정적이고 힘이 있으며, 전통적인 시김새를 적절히 사용하여 멜로디를 풍부하게 표현한다. 이주은은 중중모리의 리듬에 맞춰 유연하게 흐름을 타며, 성량을 조절하여 곡의 다양한 구간에서 적절한 강조를 할 수 있다. 그녀의 호흡은 곡의 전개에 따라 자연스럽게 이어지며, 각 구절의 마무리에서 호흡의 길이를 조절하여 리듬의 긴장감을 높이고, 전체적인 장르적 완성도를 한층 더 끌어올린다. 중중모리의 빠른 템포 속에서도 그녀의 목소리는 안정된 기조를 유지하며, 곡의 흐름과 잘 어우러져 청중에게 깊은 인상을 남긴다.
캡션(영어): Mulletaeryeong is a piece that has settled into the genre of Namdo folk songs, characterized by its roots in labor songs sung while spinning thread. This song emphasizes the joyful expression of women's labor and the sorrows of life, featuring a refrain that depicts the sound of the spinning wheel. The voice of female vocalist Lee Joo-eun leads the piece with a rich timbre, her singing being stable and powerful, while she appropriately employs traditional vocal techniques to enhance the melody. Lee Joo-eun flows flexibly with the rhythm of Jungjungmori, adjusting her vocal volume to provide suitable emphasis at various sections of the song. Her breathing naturally follows the development of the piece, and she modulates the length of her breaths at the end of each phrase to heighten the rhythmic tension, further elevating the overall genre's completeness. Even amidst the fast tempo of Jungjungmori, her voice maintains a stable foundation, harmonizing well with the flow of the piece and leaving a profound impression on the audience.
